logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, changing a wiki (repository documentation) page title through Edit resets the page's visible Revisions list to the rename commit, even though the wiki commit itself identifies a file rename with an existing parent history. Users cannot review the page's earlier content revisions from the renamed page.
logicalBugs.rootCause: renderRevisionPage queries FileCommitsCount and CommitsByFileAndRange using only the current filename. It does not follow renames to the previous filename, hiding earlier revisions.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, changing a wiki page title through Edit resets the page's visible Revisions list to the rename commit, even though the wiki commit itself identifies a file rename with an existing parent history. Users cannot review the page's earlier content revisions from the renamed page.

logicalBugs.description: A Gitea wiki is a repository’s documentation area, and its Revisions list can open a revision’s change comparison. At phone width the revision rows provide no visible way to open that comparison, although the same revision links are available and work on desktop.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Wiki history reuses commits_list where the SHA cell links to /wiki/commit. The mobile .commit-table td.sha rule hides that cell, and the wiki branch omits the alternative view-at-revision action.
reproductionPaths: A Gitea wiki is a repository’s documentation area, and its Revisions list can open a revision’s change comparison. At phone width the revision rows provide no visible way to open that comparison, although the same revision links are available and work on desktop.

logicalBugs.description: Gitea’s wiki (repository documentation) rejects duplicate titles during page creation but fails to check them when renaming. Saving a renamed page replaces another page's content without warning and removes the source page.
logicalBugs.rootCause: updateWikiPage rejects existing destination paths only in isNew mode. Edit mode removes the old path and adds the submitted content at the destination even when that destination already exists.
reproductionPaths: Gitea’s wiki rejects duplicate titles during page creation but fails to check them when renaming. Saving a renamed page replaces another page's content without warning and removes the source page.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, in a hosted wiki, relative links to other documentation pages work after saving, but Preview can turn them into absolute links using an internal localhost host forwarded by the deployment proxy. Clicking a preview link then leaves the reachable application and fails. This requires that host/proxy configuration and is not a claim that every relative wiki link or every deployment is broken.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Wiki preview Markup mode enables WithUseAbsoluteLink(true). RepoWiki.ResolveLink resolves page links relative to repoLink/wiki through its RenderContext, whose absolute-link path invokes httplib.MakeAbsoluteURL. GuessCurrentHostURL combines the forwarded/request scheme with req.Host; when the proxy forwards the internal localhost:5503 Host, preview links become https://localhost:5503/... while saved-page relative links stay on the browser host. This depends on the proxy/request-header prerequisite preserved in the original matchingGuidance; it is not evidence that an arbitrary configured ROOT_URL is always used.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, on a hosted wiki with the proxy forwarding an internal localhost host, preview a relative link to another wiki page. Preview turns it into an unreachable internal-host URL, although the same link works from the saved page, so this path depends on that deployment header configuration.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, write a new wiki (repository documentation) page body, then submit an invalid title such as an existing page name or whitespace-only text. The title error returns, but the pending body is replaced by the default "Welcome to the Wiki." content.
logicalBugs.rootCause: new.tmpl assigns the welcome text whenever PageIsWikiEdit is false, even on a POST rerender with submitted .content. Duplicate-name and whitespace-title validation preserve the form data server-side but the template overwrites its body.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, write a new wiki page body, then submit an invalid title such as an existing page name or whitespace-only text. The title error returns, but the pending body is replaced by the default "Welcome to the Wiki." content.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, on narrow wiki (repository documentation) pages, a long page title makes the closed Page selector extend beyond the viewport and can cover the adjacent Code button. The selector retains the full title width instead of truncating it, introducing horizontal scrolling that pushes article content and actions out of view.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The wiki header renders its title within a flex dropdown trigger beside action controls without a narrow-width truncation constraint. Long title text retains its width and overlaps the Code control.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, at a 320px width, a long wiki-page title covers the Code button and intercepts normal clicks.

In Gitea, at phone width, the closed 'Page: <title>' selector above a wiki page with a long title is not truncated. It runs past the right edge with its dropdown arrow off screen, and scrolling sideways to reach it pushes the article and the Edit/New/Delete buttons off the left side.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, when a wiki (repository documentation) body has unsaved edits in the legacy editor, navigating to the repository Wiki page list proceeds without a warning and silently discards the changes. The simple editor presents a dismissible navigation confirmation for the same action.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Dirty detection listens to input/change events on named form controls. EasyMDE updates the hidden textarea through forceSync and emits only a custom editor-content event from its CodeMirror change callback; it does not emit the textarea input event that the form dirty tracker requires.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, when a wiki body has unsaved edits in the legacy editor, navigating to the repository Wiki page list proceeds without a warning and silently discards the changes. The simple editor presents a dismissible navigation confirmation for the same action.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, edit a wiki (repository documentation) page’s title to a value that normalizes to no filename, such as spaces or a single dot. Save reports success and silently renames the page to unnamed instead of rejecting or explaining the normalized title.
logicalBugs.rootCause: UserTitleToWebPath trims whitespace and normalizes path segments, then substitutes unnamed for an empty result. EditWikiPost lacks the new-page whitespace-title validation and neither create nor edit tells the user when dot-only input normalizes to unnamed.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, edit a wiki page’s title to a value that normalizes to no filename, such as spaces or a single dot. Save reports success and silently renames the page to unnamed instead of rejecting or explaining the normalized title.

logicalBugs.description: Gitea’s repository wiki (repository documentation) reserves certain page names for routes, including raw. Renaming an existing page to such a reserved name opens a full-page Internal Server Error instead of leaving the editor available with a title-validation message.
logicalBugs.rootCause: updateWikiPage rejects reserved names, but EditWikiPost routes every service error to ServerError. Unlike NewWikiPost, it never handles ErrWikiReservedName by rerendering the draft with a field error.
reproductionPaths: Gitea’s repository wiki reserves certain page names for routes, including raw. Renaming an existing page to such a reserved name opens a full-page Internal Server Error instead of leaving the editor available with a title-validation message.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, create a wiki (repository documentation) page whose literal title contains a hyphen, trailing .md or plus sign, then link to it with [[Title]]. The rendered link does not match the page’s encoded storage route and opens a different page or the page list.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The wiki-style markup processor substitutes spaces and uses url.PathEscape rather than wiki.UserTitleToWebPath. It never adds the .- marker for literal hyphens or .md suffixes and leaves + unescaped for a server decoder that uses QueryUnescape, so valid titles resolve as different pages.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, create a wiki page whose literal title contains a hyphen, trailing .md or plus sign, then link to it with [[Title]]. The rendered link does not match the page’s encoded storage route and opens a different page or the page list.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, saving a wiki (repository documentation) editor opened before another user/tab changed the page silently writes its stale contents. It can overwrite a newer edit, recreate a deleted page, or recreate the old title after a rename without warning that the page changed while the editor was open.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The web form submits title/content/message but no starting commit or blob ID. updateWikiPage reads the current HEAD and writes submitted content without comparing it with the revision opened by the editor, overwriting newer content or recreating an old/deleted path.
reproductionPaths: The wiki editor carries no record of the revision it was opened from, so saving an editor opened before another save replaces the page with the older body. The newer saved change disappears without warning, unlike Gitea's file editor and issue editor, which reject the same stale save.

If a wiki page is renamed in one tab and an editor opened earlier in another tab then saves a body-only edit, Gitea silently creates a new page at the old title instead of warning or editing the renamed page, splitting the content across two pages.
In Gitea, if a wiki page is deleted in one tab, saving an editor for that page that was opened earlier in another tab silently creates the page again, with no warning that it was deleted.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, at phone width, opening a wiki's Page picker when one page has a long title sizes the menu to that title with no width cap. The menu runs off the right edge and the whole page scrolls sideways, clipping the wiki's left edge.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The floating filter dropdown renders every full page title as an item and allows content-driven menu width. A single long title therefore widens the menu beyond phone width and increases horizontal scroll area.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, at phone width, opening a wiki's Page picker when one page has a long title sizes the menu to that title with no width cap. The menu runs off the right edge and the whole page scrolls sideways, clipping the wiki's left edge.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea’s standard Markdown toolbar used by wiki (repository documentation) pages and release notes, a heading button inserts # markers at the caret instead of making the current line a heading. Selecting text and changing heading levels can stack prefixes such as "# ## ### Heading" rather than replace the existing level.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The shared combomarkdowneditor template uses markdown-toolbar-element md-header directly. Its selection-prefix operation is not adapted to select the whole current line or normalize an existing heading prefix, so both caret insertion and repeated level changes retain incorrect Markdown.
reproductionPaths: In a Gitea wiki page’s standard Markdown editor, place the cursor at the end of an existing text line and click a heading button without selecting the line. The heading marker is appended after the text, leaving ordinary text in Preview instead of converting the line into a heading.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea’s EasyMDE Markdown editor used for wiki (repository documentation) pages and release notes, toolbar tooltips advertise formatting shortcuts such as "Bold (Ctrl-B)", but pressing the shortcut leaves selected text unchanged. Clicking the corresponding Bold or Italic toolbar button works.
logicalBugs.rootCause: switchToEasyMDE replaces CodeMirror extraKeys with a new map containing quick-submit and mention-navigation handlers. This discards EasyMDE formatting key bindings while its toolbar still advertises them. The Ctrl-B tooltip in the release report identifies this EasyMDE path even though that report calls it the enhanced editor; the standard textarea toolbar uses the different "Add bold text" tooltip.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea’s legacy (EasyMDE) Markdown editor, used after 'Use the legacy editor instead', the toolbar buttons' tooltips advertise shortcuts such as 'Bold (Ctrl-B)' and 'Italic (Ctrl-I)', but pressing them does nothing. The toolbar buttons themselves work.

logicalBugs.description: A Gitea wiki (repository documentation) _Footer (or other wiki page) whose Markdown starts with '---' renders without the horizontal rule, and its blank-line-separated paragraphs run together on one line. The leading '---' is treated as the start of front matter instead of a rule. Without the leading '---' the same content renders normally.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The Markdown renderer enables goldmark-meta unconditionally. A leading --- is parsed as YAML front matter rather than a horizontal rule; content before a closing delimiter/end is consumed/reformatted by that extension, affecting wiki footer/page output.
reproductionPaths: A Gitea wiki _Footer (or other wiki page) whose Markdown starts with '---' renders without the horizontal rule, and its blank-line-separated paragraphs run together on one line. The leading '---' is treated as the start of front matter instead of a rule. Without the leading '---' the same content renders normally.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea’s Markdown editor's Insert Table panel, an out-of-range size is clamped without telling the user: entering 0 Rows inserts a table with one row, and nothing indicates the value was changed.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The insert handler applies Math.max(1,Math.min(100,rows/cols)) without reporting an input error or visibly correcting the form before insertion.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea’s Markdown editor's Insert Table panel, an out-of-range size is clamped without telling the user: entering 0 Rows inserts a table with one row, and nothing indicates the value was changed.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, when a wiki (repository documentation) page's content starts with blank lines, opening it in the editor shows one fewer leading blank line than was saved, so saving it again without changes removes a blank line each time. The stored page keeps them; the editor loses one when loading.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The shared editor template writes TextareaContent immediately after the textarea opening tag. HTML parsing discards one initial LF in a textarea, so a body beginning with a blank line loses one line when loaded and resaved.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, when a wiki page's content starts with blank lines, opening it in the editor shows one fewer leading blank line than was saved, so saving it again without changes removes a blank line each time. The stored page keeps them; the editor loses one when loading.

logicalBugs.description: On a Gitea wiki documentation page with headings far apart, edit the #fragment portion of the address in the same tab to target another heading. The address changes, but the page does not scroll to that heading; both ordinary and non-ASCII heading names are affected. Clicking an in-page link or opening the complete address in a new tab works, so those different navigation paths are outside this failure.
logicalBugs.rootCause: web_src/js/markup/anchors.ts scrolls to a heading only on page load and on clicks of in-page links, adding the 'user-content-' prefix that rendered heading ids carry. There is no hashchange handler, and the browser cannot find the unprefixed fragment itself.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, on a rendered wiki page, editing the URL fragment in the address bar to another heading's anchor changes the URL but leaves the view where it was. This happens for ASCII and Unicode headings alike.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea’s simple Markdown editor, inserting a table with the toolbar's Add table button puts the table template in the text, but Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on macOS) leaves it in place. Undo works for typed text and for the Bold button.
logicalBugs.rootCause: web_src/js/features/comp/EditorMarkdown.ts textareaInsertText inserts by assigning textarea.value, which clears the browser's native undo history, whereas the Bold button (@github/markdown-toolbar-element) inserts through the browser's editing commands and stays undoable.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea’s simple Markdown editor, inserting a table with the toolbar's Add table button puts the table template in the text, but Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on macOS) leaves it in place. Undo works for typed text and for the Bold button.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, at phone width, the Delete Page confirmation for a wiki (repository documentation) page with a long title is pushed past the right edge, clipping the page name and the Yes button. Scrolling sideways reveals Yes but clips the dialog's left side.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The delete modal interpolates the entire wiki title into an ordinary paragraph without a wiki-specific break or width constraint. A long unbroken title can impose an intrinsic width beyond the phone viewport; the exact modal centering/overflow contribution has not been independently reproduced here. This is a source-informed hypothesis; the exact mechanism has not been confirmed in execution.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, at phone width, the Delete Page confirmation for a wiki page with a long title is pushed past the right edge, clipping the page name and the Yes button. Scrolling sideways reveals Yes but clips the dialog's left side.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea’s wiki (repository documentation) editor, a blank save from Write shows 'Please fill out this field.' If the user then switches to Preview and clicks Save Page again, nothing happens: no message and no navigation, so the user isn't told why the page won't save.
logicalBugs.rootCause: web_src/js/features/comp/ComboMarkdownEditor.ts validateTextareaNonEmpty sets textarea.required = true when the blank textarea is visible and never clears it. In Preview the textarea is hidden, so the browser's native required check blocks the submit silently (a hidden control cannot show its bubble) before the submit handler in web_src/js/features/repo-wiki.ts can run and show the 'Require non-empty content' toast.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea’s wiki editor, a blank save from Write shows 'Please fill out this field.' If the user then switches to Preview and clicks Save Page again, nothing happens: no message and no navigation, so the user isn't told why the page won't save.
